Get Flanders Heritage Inventory designation objects (aanduidingsobjecten)

get_oe_aanduidingsobjecten.Rd

`get_oe_aanduidingsobjecten()` get an OGC Simple Features collection containing the designated heritage sites (protected sites and inventorised immovable heritage). The data is downloaded from https://geo.onroerenderfgoed.be/downloads. The coordinate reference system is EPSG:31370.

Usage

get_oe_aanduidingsobjecten(layer = "aanduidingsobjecten")

Arguments

layer

layer to be returned from the downloaded zip file. Default value is 'aanduidingsobjecten', containing all types of designation objects. Other values are:

aanduidingsobjecten_historiek

Designation objects, including designations that are no longer valid.

bes_arch_site

Protected archaeological sites / Beschermde archeologische sites

bes_landschap

Protected Landscape / Beschermd cultuurhistorische landschappen

bes_monument

Protected Monument / Beschermd monumenten

bes_overgangszone

Transitional zone' / Overganszones

bes_sd_gezicht

Protected cityscape, / Beschermde stads- of dorpsgezichten

erfgoedls

Heritage landscape / Erfgoedlandschap

gga

Area where no archaeology is to be expected / Gebieden waar geen archeologie te verwachten valt

unesco_kern

UNESCO World Heritage site - core area / UNESCO werelderfgoed - kernzones

unesco_buffer

UNESCO World Heritage site - buffer area / UNESCO werelderfgoed - bufferzones

vast_az

Archaeological zone / Vastgestelde archeologische zone

vast_be

Architectural heritage / Vastgesteld bouwkundig erfgoed

vast_la

Landscape atlas / Vastgestelde landschapsatlas

vast_le

Landscape elements / Vastgestelde landschapselementen

Value

An object of class sf (see st_read). The object has a comment containing the retrieval_time and retrieval_url.

get_oe_aanduidingsobjecten()
